Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
Kevin M. <you...@imaspammer.org> wrote:
>What Janne means is that, when newsgroup posting via Google Groups,
>Google removes '[' and ']' and everything inbetween from propogating
>out to other news servers.

Except it doesn't.

The original post in this thread has [TWD] in it on both Google Groups
and other news servers. For reasons best known to Google, they hide the
[TWD] when you see the post turn up on the summary page for the
newsgroup, but show it when you look at the individual post or thread.

The [TWD] is very definitely then propagated out to other news servers -
the original post in this thread very definitely says [TWD] on the
handful of news servers I have access to.

However, when someone replies to the post in Google Groups, Google has a
tendency to then remove [TWD] form the Subject of the reply - so a
subject of "[TWD] Blah" just becomes "Re: Blah" in the reply. That post
is then shown on Google Groups without the [TWD] in its subject, and
that's also propagated to other news servers.

I'm not 100% sure what would happen if someone hit Reply to a thread in
Google Groups and then manually added [TWD] back in.
